items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was, he was murdered just a... a couple of weeks ago maybe.

ctx.x: He was, he was murdered just a... a couple of weeks ago maybe. Somebody broke in, went into his apartment and beat him up. The guy was in a wheelchair. And he was in the hospital a long time and then just yesterday, he died. Isn’t that wild? On 12th Street, Ramsey Clark lives here. (laughs)
Well, I was gonna say, this is a great time to talk about the neighborhood.
